svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 320 x 260 mm from 8 mm steel plate; square the edges, round the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners to about 5 mm and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the front edge (the operator's side) and sideways from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line. The hole picture in the plan repeats every position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lift screw hole 25 mm on the centre line, 110 mm from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bench bolt holes 11 mm, 145 mm each side, 15 and 245 mm from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shield feet: drill 5.0 and tap M6, 126 mm each side, 40 and 160 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front. Fan bracket: drill 5.0, tap M6, 146 mm right, 70 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the column outline: 80 x 60 mm, centred, 175 to 235 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge. The column is welded here in assembly step 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the shield feet and fan bracket on it; the holes line up.
